pairs: I am speaking the truth in Christ;
testimonium mihi perhibente conscientia mea in Spiritu Sancto:
My conscience offers testimony to me in the Holy Spirit,
because the sadness within me is great,
and there is a continuous sorrow in my heart.
Optabam enim ego ipse anathema esse a Christo pro fratribus meis,
For I was desiring that I myself might be anathemized from Christ, for the sake of my brothers,
qui sunt cognati mei secundum carnem,
who are my kinsmen according to the flesh.
to whom belongs adoption as sons,
et ex quibus est Christus secundum carnem,
and from them, according to the flesh, is the Christ,
qui est super omnia Deus benedictus in sæcula.
who is over all things, blessed God, for all eternity.
Non autem quod exciderit verbum Dei.
But it is not that the Word of God has perished.
Non enim omnes qui ex Israël sunt, ii sunt Israëlitæ:
For not all those who are Israelites are of Israel.
neque qui semen sunt Abrahæ, omnes filii:
And not all sons are the offspring of Abraham:
sed in Isaac vocabitur tibi semen:
“For your offspring will be invoked in Isaac.”
non qui filii carnis, hi filii Dei:
those who are the sons of God are not those who are sons of the flesh,
but those who are sons of the Promise;
these are considered to be the offspring.
For the word of promise is this:
“I will return at the proper time.
And there shall be a son for Sarah.”
et Rebecca ex uno concubitu habens,
having conceived by Isaac our father,
when the children had not yet been born,
and had not yet done anything good
aut mali (ut secundum electionem propositum Dei maneret),
or bad (such that the purpose of God might be based on their choice),
sed ex vocante dictum est ei quia major serviet minori,
but because of a calling, it was said to her: “The elder shall serve the younger.”
And I will offer mercy to whomever I will pity.”
Therefore, it is not based on those who choose,
but on God who takes pity.
For Scripture says to the Pharaoh:
Quia in hoc ipsum excitavi te,
“I have raised you up for this purpose,
ut ostendam in te virtutem meam:
so that I may reveal my power by you,
et ut annuntietur nomen meum in universa terra.
and so that my name may be announced to all the earth.”
Therefore, he takes pity on whomever he wills,
and he hardens whomever he wills.
And so, you would say to me:
Quid adhuc queritur? voluntati enim ejus quis resistit?
“Then why does he still find fault? For who can resist his will?”
O man, who are you to question God?
qui respondeas Deo? numquid dicit figmentum ei qui se finxit:
How can the thing that has been formed say to the One who formed him:
“Why have you made me this way?”
an non habet potestatem figulus luti ex eadem massa facere aliud quidem vas in honorem, aliud vero in contumeliam?
And does not the potter have the authority over the clay to make, from the same material, indeed, one vessel unto honor, yet truly another unto disgrace?
Quod si Deus volens ostendere iram, et notum facere potentiam suam,
What if God, wanting to reveal his wrath and to make his power known,
sustinuit in multa patientia vasa iræ,
endured, with much patience, vessels deserving wrath,
ut ostenderet divitias gloriæ suæ in vasa misericordiæ,
so that he might reveal the wealth of his glory, within these vessels of mercy,
which he has prepared unto glory?
And so it is with those of us whom he has also called,
et vocavit nos non solum ex Judæis,
not only from among the Jews,
but even from among the Gentiles,
just as he says in Hosea:
“I will call those who were not my people,
and she who was not beloved,
and she who had not obtained mercy,
in loco, ubi dictum est eis:
in the place where it was said to them,
there they shall be called the sons of the living God.”
And Isaiah cried out on behalf of Israel:
Si fuerit numerus filiorum Israël tamquam arena maris,
“When the number of the sons of Israel is like the sand of the sea,
For he shall complete his word,
while abbreviating it out of equity.
quia verbum breviatum faciet Dominus super terram:
For the Lord shall accomplish a brief word upon the earth.”
And it is just as Isaiah predicted:
Nisi Dominus Sabaoth reliquisset nobis semen,
“Unless the Lord of hosts had bequeathed offspring,
we would have become like Sodom,
and we would have been made similar to Gomorrah.”
Quod gentes, quæ non sectabantur justitiam, apprehenderunt justitiam:
That the Gentiles who did not follow justice have attained justice,
justitiam autem, quæ ex fide est.
even the justice that is of faith.
Yet truly, Israel, though following the law of justice,
has not arrived at the law of justice.
Because they did not seek it from faith,
but as if it were from works.
For they stumbled over a stumbling block,
Ecce pono in Sion lapidem offensionis,
I am placing a stumbling block in Zion,
et omnis qui credit in eum,
But whoever believes in him shall not be confounded.”
